skill.name: container-orchestration
skill.description: Guides Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, Helm, and AWS ECS/Fargate container deployment patterns with templates and reference commands.
skill.summary: Create and review container deployment patterns across Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and AWS Fargate.
skill.author: 0xDarkMatter

security_audit.summary: Most blocker findings are false positives from Markdown fences, Docker health checks, and standard Dockerfile cleanup. Confirmed issues include insecure sample credentials, default Compose database credentials, an all-interfaces debug listener, an executable build/push helper, and broad Kubernetes secret-read RBAC. No prompt-injection attempt or hidden exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Default and literal credentials appear in Compose and Kubernetes examples.
remediation.suggestion: Replace sample passwords and API keys with placeholders, secret manager references, or required environment variables without defaults.

remediation.issue: The Kubernetes Role can list secrets in the namespace.
remediation.suggestion: Remove list access and grant get only for the exact Secret names each workload needs.

remediation.issue: The debug container example listens on all interfaces.
remediation.suggestion: Bind debug tooling to localhost or clearly mark the debug target as local-only and disabled for shared environments.

remediation.issue: The build-push helper can build and push images when executed.
remediation.suggestion: Document required user confirmation, registry review, tag review, and Docker context review before running the script.

content.user_title: Deploy Containers with Docker, Kubernetes, and Fargate
content.value_statement: Container deployment work often needs repeatable templates for Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and Fargate. This skill provides production-oriented patterns, examples, and checklists for planning and reviewing deployments.
actual_capabilities: Drafts Dockerfile and Docker Compose patterns for Python, Node.js, and Go services.
Explains Kubernetes Deployment, Service, Ingress, HPA, PDB, RBAC, and NetworkPolicy examples.
Provides Helm chart structure, values patterns, and common Helm command references.
Compares ECS Fargate and Kubernetes choices for AWS container workloads.
Includes a Bash helper for building and optionally pushing Docker images.
limitations: It does not validate manifests against a live cluster or cloud account.
Examples require project-specific review before production use.
The included script can modify local Docker state when executed.
Some sample secrets and credentials must be replaced before use.

use_cases.title: Plan a Container Baseline
use_cases.description: Create a Dockerfile and Compose starting point before a service enters deployment review.

use_cases.title: Review Kubernetes Readiness
use_cases.description: Check manifest patterns for probes, resources, security context, scaling, and network policy coverage.

use_cases.title: Choose an AWS Runtime
use_cases.description: Compare ECS Fargate and Kubernetes tradeoffs for an AWS container platform decision.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Docker Starter
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Dockerfile and Docker Compose plan for my service. Runtime: [runtime]. Port: [port]. Health endpoint: [path].

prompt_templates.title: Review a Compose Stack
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Docker Compose design for local development. Check health checks, volumes, networks, and secret handling.

prompt_templates.title: Design Kubernetes Manifests
prompt_templates.prompt: Design Kubernetes manifests for my service. Include deployment, service, ingress, probes, resources, security context, and scaling notes.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Fargate and Kubernetes
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare ECS Fargate and Kubernetes for this workload. Include operations, networking, secrets, scaling, cost, and deployment risks.

output_examples.input: Create a Dockerfile plan for a Python API.
output_examples.output: A multi-stage build outline with dependency caching, non-root execution, health checks, and runtime environment notes.

output_examples.input: Review a Kubernetes manifest for production readiness.
output: Highlights missing probes, resource limits, and security context settings.
Calls out risky secret handling and broad RBAC permissions.
Suggests rollout, autoscaling, and network policy improvements.

output_examples.input: Compare ECS Fargate and Kubernetes for an AWS web service.
output_examples.output: A decision summary covering operational burden, portability, AWS integrations, networking, IAM roles, scaling, and cost controls.

best_practices: Replace example credentials with secret manager references before generating final files.
Ask for runtime, ports, health endpoints, and deployment target before creating templates.
Review generated commands before running Bash, Docker, kubectl, Helm, or AWS actions.
anti_patterns: Copying sample credentials directly into production manifests.
Running the build-push script without checking registry, tag, Dockerfile, and context.
Granting broad Kubernetes secret access when one named secret is enough.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy containers automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides patterns, examples, and a helper script that must be run separately.

faq.question: Can it generate Kubernetes manifests?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Deployment, Service, Ingress, HPA, PDB, RBAC, and NetworkPolicy examples.

faq.question: Does it support Helm?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents chart structure, values files, templates, and common Helm commands.

faq.question: Can it help choose ECS Fargate or Kubernetes?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares operational burden, portability, AWS integration, networking, secrets, scaling, and cost.

faq.question: Are the examples production ready as written?
faq.answer: No. Review credentials, names, ports, policies, and cloud settings before production use.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
